about: New York county and city grant programs, entered by hand from each program's own page. Not a complete list. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date (docs/county-coverage.md).

programs.title: City Council Discretionary Funding (FY2027)
programs.objectives: City Council discretionary expense funding for community organizations.
programs.who: Not-for-profit community-based organizations with IRS tax-exempt status, usually 501(c)(3); some other 501(c) types may qualify. Fiscal sponsors and fiscal conduits are not allowed.
programs.application: Submit the Council application in the January to February filing period.
programs.deadlines: FY2027 applications closed February 18, 2026. The Council opens a filing period each year; no next date is published.

programs.title: Borough President Discretionary Expense Funding
programs.agency: Office of the Queens Borough President
programs.objectives: Discretionary funding for nonprofit programmatic expenses in Queens.
programs.who: Nonprofits that meet the office's guidelines.
programs.application: The page gives January to June for applications; nonprofits must meet the office's guidelines.
programs.deadlines: Applications are taken January to June; the page gives no exact dates.
programs.source_note: The office's guidelines are in a document that couldn't be read, so check them for matching funds and tax status rules.

programs.title: Borough President Discretionary Expense Funding
programs.agency: Office of the Brooklyn Borough President
programs.objectives: Programs, services and events of nonprofits that directly support Brooklyn and its residents.
programs.application: Complete the Discretionary Expense Funding Application linked on the page.
programs.deadlines: The page gives no application dates.
programs.source_note: The page gives no tax status or matching rules for this funding, and the application form wasn't read.
